subject: Blocker: third-party SDK handshake failure — trial runway & credits request
messages:
From: Luis Ortega <luis@fastpay.io>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Caroline Park <caroline@fastpay.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Blocker: third-party SDK handshake failure — PoC stalled

Hi Sofia,

Quickly looping you in — we've hit a hard stop integrating Redwood into our transaction validation pipeline. The external payments SDK (vendor: PayLite) is failing the mutual TLS handshake intermittently during full-load tests; engineers suspect library version conflicts in their diffed dependency tree. The symptom is a persistent 503 / connection reset after 30s under fanout, which surfaces during our end-to-end smoke tests.

Our team is tied up chasing vendor patches and dependency pinning; this will push our demo and acceptance window by at least 2–3 weeks unless we extend the sandbox and preserve our trial quota. Can Redwood provide: 
- a 30-day trial extension on the PoC window, and
- a short-term sandbox credit (we estimate ~200k tokens) so we can continue iterative testing while PayLite patches their client.

I've attached the last 200 lines of the error trace for context (error_log_tail.txt).

We appreciate any flexibility — this deal is moving quickly on our side but the integration dependency is the blocking factor.

Best,
Luis Ortega
Senior Engineering Manager, FastPay
(attachment: error_log_tail.txt — text)
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Luis Ortega <luis@fastpay.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Blocker: third-party SDK handshake failure — PoC stalled

Hi Luis — thanks for the details and the log. Sorry to hear this popped up during load tests.

Short answers: we can escalate and review credits/runway, but I need an internal sign-off. A few quick items that will speed our side:
- Confirm ETA from PayLite on a patch or a workable temporary pin (if you have a vendor ticket number).
- The exact token burn rate you're seeing (rough estimate per day during smoke runs).

I'll push for a 30-day extension and a sandbox credit while we triage. Can we do a 20-minute triage call today at 2pm PT so our infra engineer can look at the logs live? If 2pm doesn't work, propose a time.

On our side I'll loop Marissa (CS lead) and Ben (sales lead) for approval and to record the adjustment in HubSpot.

Sofia Ivanova
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: FW: FastPay PoC — extension & credits request

Sofia / Ben — forwarding FastPay's note. Quick recap from CS lens:
- This is a high-velocity PoC (FastPay is on the enterprise track; they want production SLA post-demo).
- Blocker is a third-party dependency (PayLite) outside Redwood; timeline looks like 2–3 weeks to resolve if vendor ships a patch.
- FastPay asked for 30 days + ~200k sandbox tokens so they can continue iterative runs and meet the original demo commitments.

Recommendation: approve 30 days + 200k sandbox tokens as a one-time makegood. Track as a conditional concession on deal FP-4893; require a short post-mortem and vendor ticket ID to close the loop.

I've prefilled a HubSpot note draft and attached a proposed scope_of_work.pdf with the revised PoC dates (attachment: scope_of_work.pdf).

-Marissa
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FastPay PoC — extension & credits request

Thanks for the context. Approve the one-time concession:
- 30 calendar days extension to the PoC end date (new deadline: 2027-09-10), and
- 200,000 sandbox-token credit applied to the FastPay trial account.

Conditions:
1) CS to capture vendor ticket number and short post-mortem once resolved.
2) Finance to be notified and HubSpot deal FP-4893 updated with the concession line item.

Marissa — please apply the credit and update the HubSpot record. Sofia — confirm with FastPay and schedule a follow-up in two weeks.

-Ben
Director, Sales — Redwood Inference
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Luis Ortega <luis@fastpay.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Blocker: third-party SDK handshake failure — PoC stalled

Hi Luis — quick update: we reviewed internally and approved a one-time concession to keep your PoC momentum.

What we've applied:
- PoC window extended to 2027-09-10 (30 calendar days from today).
- 200,000 sandbox-token credit applied to your FastPay trial account.

Action items for FastPay:
1) Please send the PayLite vendor ticket number (or a short note) so CS can track the remediation and close the condition on the concession.
2) Confirm whether you want the credit applied all at once or staged; default is immediate.
3) Let's keep the triage call — can we do Thu 11am PT? If so, I'll send calendar invite with our infra engineer.

Links & artifacts: hubspot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/deal/FP-4893), PoC scope (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/fastpay-poc).

(attachment: scope_of_work.pdf — updated PoC dates)

Thanks — we want to keep this moving and will help where we can.

Sofia Ivanova
